item.title: Saturnworks Active 2-way Buffered Splitter / Buffer Tuner Out with Volume Controls for Guitar or Bass Pedal - $71.10 ($10)
item.description:
A Saturnworks active splitter splits your signal without level or tone loss. 

Need to split your signal? Many players first reach for a Y-cable, but quickly learn that simply splitting a standard (high impedance) guitar signal with a Y-cable can kill your tone and cause signal loss. Putting a buffer before the split is better, but with that setup, the level of one side of the split may affect the level of the other side. 

The Saturnworks buffered splitter is the best way to keep your tone strong and clear and to eliminate signal interaction between channels. The volume control version adds volume controls to trim the level of each output. The Saturnworks buffered splitter isn't just a single buffer followed by a signal split. The "dual" in the Saturnworks dual active splitter means that this pedal takes one input signal and splits it into two individually buffered outputs. Each output has its own buffer. This keeps both signals strong and eliminates any levels interaction between channels. 

Interesting in setting up a parallel signal path for your rig? You can pair our active splitter with our 2-channel active summer to create a 2-channel parallel setup that allows you create unique blends of sounds. Or check out our listing for the Saturnworks parallel pedal that combines a 2-channel active splitter and 2-channel active summer into one convenient enclosure.

The buffered splitter also works great as an always-on tuner out.

This pedal can also be set up specifically for bass. If you'd like it set up for bass, please send us a message after you check to request the bass setup. 

The Saturnworks buffered splitter offers boutique grade components and features including: 

  • A cast-aluminum 4.39” 2.4″ x 1.24” (1590B size).
  • Heavy-duty Neutrik 1/4" TS jacks.
  • The buffered splitter is powered by standard 9v DC center-negative power with a top quality 2.1mm Lumberg brand power jack.
  • A current draw of approximately 3mA.
  • Power filtering for quieter operation.
  • An input impedance of 1M and an output impedance of <100 ohms. 
  • High quality wire made in the USA. 
  • Handcrafted and bench-tested in California, USA. 
  • A 1-year limited warranty against parts and manufacturing defects. See saturnworkspedals.com for warranty terms and conditions.

Check out saturnworkspedals.com for the full Saturnworks lineup.
